summary.question: The customer on service svc186 (100GE between S19 and S12) reports a loss of service from about t=660 s. What is the cause?

llm.report: The system could not determine a single cause. It identified four candidates: NONE_OF_THESE, PROTECTION_SWITCH_HIT@el:och98(), WSS_FILTER_SHIFT@el:oms.S10-S19|4(), and SOP_TRANSIENT@el:oms.S10-S19.span0(). The candidate set has probability 0.913, and the system indicates the actual cause was probably not considered. Retuning spare lightpath och98 at end a did not clear the issue; errors persisted on receiver trx.och98.a. Swapping unit oms.S10-S19.amp3 also left the symptoms unchanged.
